definition: A point on a graph that is at least as high as every point close to it, like the top of a hill. There $f'(x) = 0$ for a smooth curve.
A point on a graph that is at least as low as every point close to it, like the bottom of a valley. There $f'(x) = 0$ for a smooth curve.
A point where a graph changes between concave-up and concave-down, so $f''(x) = 0$ and $f''(x)$ changes sign there.
